message.content:
**Uno – Quick‑Start Rules** | Section | What you need | How it works | |---------|---------------|--------------| | **Deck** | 108 cards: 4 colors (Red, Yellow, Green, Blue). Each color has numbers 0‑9 (two of each 1‑9, one 0) and four action cards:
• *Skip* (S) – next player loses a turn.
• *Reverse* (R) – changes play direction.
• *Draw Two* (D2) – next player draws two cards and loses a turn.
• *Wild* (W) – player chooses the next color.
• *Wild Draw Four* (W4) – player chooses the next color and next player draws four cards. | Shuffle the deck and deal 7 cards to each player. Place the remaining cards face‑down to form the draw pile. Turn the top card over to start the discard pile. | | **Objective** | Be the first player to score **500 points** (or a pre‑agreed total). Points are tallied at the end of each round. | | **Gameplay** | 1. Play proceeds clockwise (unless a Reverse changes direction). 2. On your turn, you may play **one** card that matches either the **color** or the **number/symbol** of the top discard. 3. If you cannot play, you must draw one card from the draw pile. If that card can be played, you may play it immediately; otherwise, your turn ends. | | **Action Cards** | • **Skip** – next player misses a turn.
• **Reverse** – reverses play direction (in a 2‑player game it acts like a Skip).
• **Draw Two** – next player draws two cards and skips their turn.
• **Wild** – you declare the next color. You may play this on any card.
• **Wild Draw Four** – same as Wild, but the next player must draw four cards and skip a turn. **You may only play this if you have no other playable card** (see “Challenge” below). | | **Winning a Round** | When a player discards their last card, the round ends. That player scores points equal to the sum of the values of all cards remaining in opponents’ hands:
• Number cards = face value.
• Skip, Reverse, Draw Two = 20 points.
• Wild, Wild Draw Four = 50 points. | | **Scoring** | Add the round score to the winner’s total. Play continues until someone reaches the target score (usually 500). | | **Special Rules** | • **UNO Call** – When you have one card left, you must say “UNO!” before the next player takes their turn. If you forget and another player catches you, you must draw two penalty cards.
• **Challenge Wild Draw Four** – If you suspect the player who played W4 had a playable card, you may challenge. If they had a playable card, you draw four cards instead of the opponent drawing. If they were honest, you draw six cards.
• **Stacking** – Some house rules allow stacking Draw Two or Wild Draw Four cards (e.g., if you’re faced with a D2, you can play another D2 to pass the penalty). This is not in the official rule set but is common in casual play. | | **House Variations** | • **Draw 4 to win** – The first player to draw 4 cards wins the round immediately.
• **No Wild Draw Four** – Some groups play without the W4 card.
• **Speed Uno** – Play as fast as possible; the first to finish all cards wins. | --- ### Quick Play Summary 1. **Setup** – Shuffle, deal 7 cards each, flip top card to start discard pile. 2. **Turn** – Play a matching card or draw. 3. **Action** – Follow the effect of Skip, Reverse, Draw Two, Wild, or Wild Draw Four. 4. **UNO** – Say “UNO!” when you’re down to one card. 5. **Round End** – Last card discarded → score points. 6. **Game End** – First to reach target score wins. Enjoy the colorful chaos of Uno!
